title: JANUS Tear falsification campaign
definition: A JANUS Tear is a compact independently checkable invariant condensed from one or more residual SAT states.

canonical_context.boundary: C020 does not refute H127; it attacks broader all-state and concrete policy Tear formulations.

terminal_formulation_result.name: polynomial continuation-complete quotient of all residual states
terminal_formulation_result.reason: E_n(X,Y)=AND_i(x_i<->y_i) has O(n) size but produces 2^n pairwise continuation-distinguishable residuals after assigning X.

positive_result.tear: one component-charge parity bit per component

simulation_attack.rejected_assumption: Exact residual memoization merely creates an ordinary Resolution DAG with O(1) overhead per cache edge.
simulation_attack.reason: Formula caching is a separate proof-complexity resource; a Policy-0A to Resolution or Res(oplus) p-simulation is not established.

policy0t.definition: Policy-0A without exact residual memoization; every recursive occurrence is charged.
policy0t.target: Emit and verify a Resolution proof of size O(full tree work) and depth O(N), then apply the MAJ3 width-to-depth lifting theorem.
policy0t.boundary: Would eliminate only this explicit no-cache policy.

tear_trilemma.decision_only: Only two classes are needed, but extracting the class is SAT and is circular.
tear_trilemma.continuation_complete: The equality family forces exponentially many classes.
tear_trilemma.policy_selected: An explicit polynomial policy that always succeeds is already a polynomial-time SAT algorithm.

surviving_candidate.name: JANUS Tear Guided-Policy Candidate
surviving_candidate.statement: One explicit polynomial-time Tear language and transition policy generates only polynomially many polynomially verifiable Tears and states on every CNF and returns a SAT witness or sound rejection artifact.
surviving_candidate.consequence_if_true: SAT is in P and therefore P=NP.

next_gate: Certify Policy-0T's proof translation and separately classify or lower-bound Policy-0A's exact formula-caching calculus.
claim_boundary: No result proves P=NP, proves P!=NP, refutes H127, or imports Resolution lower bounds across an unproved caching simulation.
